subject: Capacity safeguard proposal for renewal
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@uptide.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: repeated short outages ahead of renewal

Hi Sergio,

Wanted to flag two short service interruptions last week (Apr 2 and Apr 7) that caused timeouts for several user-facing flows. We aggregate a lot of inference calls, so even ~30s blips translate to real customer impact. Renewal for our annual commitment is coming up May 8 and the finance team is asking for stronger uptime guarantees or a plan we can point to in the renewal.

Can you share what mitigation options Redwood can offer that would reduce the risk of recurrence? Specifically:
- Is there a way to guarantee a higher effective availability for our production traffic?
- Can we get a path to lower-latency tails during peak windows?
- Would Redwood consider a short-term credit for the two incidents while we evaluate longer-term mitigation?

Attaching our incident summary (overview only). Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Product Operations
UpTide Technologies

Attachment: uptime_incident_log_20270402.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@uptide.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: repeated short outages ahead of renewal

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and for sharing the incident log. I’m sorry for the disruption; I know these interruptions hit hard when you have latency-sensitive endpoints.

I’ve looped in Monica (CS) and Rishi (Infra) so we can both diagnose root causes and put a concrete mitigation plan in front of you before renewal. High-level options we can move quickly on:

1) Capacity Safeguard (short-term): reserve an isolated burst pool for your production routes (isolated nodes + prioritized routing). This reduces noisy-neighbor risk and raises effective availability for your traffic.
2) Dedicated Pilot (medium-term): a dedicated small GPU cluster for your busiest models — predictable latency and priority scheduling.
3) Credits: we can discuss a one-time credit for the two incidents while a mitigation is in place.

Can we do a 30-minute working session on Wednesday 14th at 11:00 PT to walk the proposal? I’ll draft specifics after Rishi confirms feasibility and Marissa confirms commercial terms.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

(On internal note: Monica/Rishi/Marissa — please see Olivia’s log attached. Prioritize investigation for Apr 2 spike; initial hypothesis: preemption during cross-tenant batch spike. Need feasibility and cost delta for isolated burst pool.)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: repeated short outages ahead of renewal

Team — quick tech assessment: we reviewed the logs Olivia sent. Two short failure modes surfaced:

- Apr 2: transient GPU OOM on the shared autopool during a large batched scoring job from another tenant; eviction + reschedule added ~23–45s tail for some requests.
- Apr 7: network egress latency spike in the hosting region (provider-side) — affected a subset of hosts; recovery was within 60s.

Mitigations:
- Capacity Safeguard (isolated burst pool): low-friction, can be provisioned in ~5 business days for UpTide using existing reserved capacity. Cost: +12% over current unit pricing (short-term monthly premium) with a 14-day trial option.
- Dedicated Pilot: provisioning and testing 2–3 weeks; higher cost (reserved cluster) but best for long-term predictability.
- Tail latency tuning: we can apply prefix caching + tighter batching caps for your routes immediately (config change) — negligible cost, moderate latency improvement.

Recommendation: offer the Capacity Safeguard + immediate prefix-caching changes, plus a one-time goodwill credit for Apr incidents (amount TBD by commercial). Aditya, can you prep a 1-page deployment plan for the safeguard (nodes, routing policy, rollback)?

Rishi
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@uptide.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity safeguard proposal and options (formal)

Hi Olivia — following our call, please find an attached proposal that summarizes the options we discussed and a recommended path forward. Short summary here:

Option A — Capacity Safeguard (recommended, fast):
- Isolated burst pool provisioned for UpTide routes (priority routing, dedicated hosts during bursts)
- Timeline: provisioning in 5 business days; optional 14-day evaluation period
- Commercial: +12% on per-token units while the safeguard is active; standard usage billing otherwise

Option B — Dedicated Pilot (best long-term predictability):
- Dedicated GPU cluster for your production models, SLA uplift to 99.95% for that cluster
- Timeline: 2–3 weeks to provision and validate
- Commercial: reserved contract, pricing to be discussed (volume discounts apply)

Additional immediate actions (no cost):
- Deploy prefix caching and tighter batch caps on production routes (Rishi will push these config changes within 24 hours)

Commercial concession: we propose a one-time credit to offset the two incidents; I’ve asked Marissa to review and confirm the amount.

Attachments: capacity_safeguard_proposal_20270415.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)

If Option A looks good we can put together a short addendum to your existing renewal and get the safeguard live before May 8. Please let me know if you want a draft addendum and a DocuSign link.

Best,
Sergio

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@uptide.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: uptide-support@uptide.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity safeguard proposal and options (formal)

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the quick follow-up and the clear options. We reviewed the proposal internally. Two asks before we sign:

1) We want Option A (Capacity Safeguard) to be live by May 2 so we have a week observing behavior before renewal on May 8. Is the 5-business-day timeline feasible if we start provisioning this week?
2) We’d like a one-time credit to cover the customer impact from Apr 2 and Apr 7. Our finance team suggests a credit equivalent to one month of our current committed spend.

We’re generally comfortable with the +12% premium for the trial period if the safeguard materially reduces tail latency. We’re attaching the detailed incident output for Apr 2 for your engineering team.

Quote from the proposal included below: "If Option A looks good we can put together a short addendum..." — yes, please share the DocuSign addendum and we’ll route for signature ASAP.

Thanks — Olivia

Attachment: uptide_incident_detailed_20270402.csv (CSV, 120KB)

Subject: Finalizing: UpTide signs Option A + credit ask (internal)

Team — quick update for the renewal runway: Olivia confirmed they will take Option A and want the safeguard live by May 2. They also requested a one-time credit equal to one month of committed spend.

Proposed internal approvals/next steps:
- Marissa: please confirm commercial amount for the one-month credit and whether we can do a 50%/net-approval concession or need full GTM sign-off.
- Finance: we’ll route a credit memo once Marissa confirms amount.
- Rishi/Aditya: provisioning plan for the isolated burst pool — target provisioning start Monday 26 Apr, go-live target May 1 EOD PT so UpTide has May 2 observation window. Rishi to confirm rollback window and monitoring hooks.
- Sergio: I will prepare the addendum + DocuSign envelope (link to be shared once Marissa confirms the credit). HubSpot deal updated: UPT-2027-042.

Marissa — can you confirm approval path today so we can get the DocuSign out to UpTide tomorrow?

—Sergio
